correctness.rationale: Zapletal 2026 states Con(ZFC)⇒Con(ZF+DC+BPI+no E0-selector), where a Vitali set is an eventual-equality selector. Larson–Zapletal, Observation 3.13, establishes under ZF+DC: existence of a Hamel basis R/Q ⇒ a total E0-selector. By modus tollens within Zapletal’s model, no Hamel basis can exist there. BPI⇒Hahn–Banach is standard. This correctly proves a relative consistency/nonimplication, not that BPI entails no basis. Zapletal full 2026 preprint was inaccessible, so exact construction was not checked; its directly relevant published theorem statement and the fully read older implication suffice for this conditional corollary.
